title: Pädokriminelle Foren: Warum löscht niemand die Aufnahmen? | STRG_F
summary: A German STRG_F investigation into why child sexual abuse material stays online on forums, following a father whose daughter's abuse images were widely shared. The reporters tried to get the content removed by contacting hosters.
why: HN cites it as evidence that journalists could remove most of a forum's content with simple hoster requests, in debates about CSAM and Tor.

quote.text: reporters / journalists managed to delete the majority of content from one such CSAM forum
